recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up work is needed for FHIR-12466 unless a future independent editorial pass modernizes the broader support-links wording.
issue_request: FHIR-12466 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive FHIR-core change request for overview.html section 2.2.6.4, asking to replace the outdated phrase "mass Skype chats" with "online chat system" or similar because chat.fhir.org/Zulip had supplanted the prior Skype chats.
initial_application: The change was explicitly applied by git commit 69a658a0b7af9cf0af86f4c9f0eb23e1eb790785 on 2017-02-10, whose subject references #12466 and whose patch changed source/overview.html from "mass Skype chats" to "online chat system". The Jira comment records svn @11106, consistent with that application.
additional_context: source/overview.html is the source page for the build URL named in Jira, build.fhir.org/overview.html. Current source line 175 and the current rendered build page both contain "online chat system". Related/community searching found no substantive Zulip or Confluence discussion that would alter the Jira/source conclusion; Zulip only had the tracker bot announcement for the phrase.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current FHIR source already implements the requested wording and no source edit is necessary.
